title: The Restless Dead
summary: Forge an answer to your build's weakness, then prove the adaptation in Moonlit Graves.

chain.title: Chapter II — Resonant Paths
chain.description: Identify a weakness, craft an answer, and carry the adapted build through Moonlit Graves.
chain.goal: Reach level 20 after crafting a Tier 1 equipment answer for your build.
chain.promisedReward: Choose one of three guaranteed Essences for your third slot.

choice.selectionSummary: Choose whether your third slot adds control, finishing pressure, or sustain and vulnerability.
choice.confirmationText: This Essence will be awarded when you complete Chapter II.

options.title: Claim the Frost Imp Essence
options.summary: A magical control option with a hard-hitting spell and Basic Attacks that apply Chill.

options.title: Claim the Grave Hound Essence
options.summary: A physical finisher that pressures the weakest enemy and opens combat by slowing every foe.

options.title: Claim the Lost Soul Essence
options.summary: A magical sustain option that drains health and exposes a random enemy to extra damage.

objectives.description: Forge an Answer: craft one Tier 1 equipment item that supports your build.
Win 5 encounters in Moonlit Graves with your adapted build.
Reach character level 20 to unlock Twilight Clearing and your third Essence slot.
